en: Hey, you're Haruka! The one who had that great battle against Akari at the Summit!
Oh, hello, Mittsu-san. I haven't seen you for a while. What're you doing here?
Ah, it's such a long and painful story!
You see, after the Summit I lost my wallet. Even worse, my return plane ticket was in there! My poor, precious ticket...
Oh no! What are you going to do?
I know, right? That's exactly what I said!
But then I got an idea. I'm going to organize dance battles here to make enough money to buy another ticket!
Organize dance battles?
Whenever somebody is looking for a dance battle opponent, I'll set them up with other dancers I know.
And then I'll charge a small fee for my services. You know, to go towards replacing the ticket I lost.
That's a pretty good idea.
I know! How about you, Haruka? Are you tough enough to take on opponents you can't find anywhere else?
Oh, well... I understand you're in a tough situation, Mittsu-san, but I can't help but feel I'm being pushed into this.
All right, fine. I won't force you! But come back if you ever feel brave enough to try!

You can now compete in free dance battles.

Talk to the organizer, Mittsu, to have him arrange a battle with a dancer you wouldn't ordinarily get to meet in the streets.
These opponents will be rivals you've competed against in the past. More opponents will be added when you perform certain jobs.
So, you actually dared to show your face here again, did you? I'll admit, you do look a little more confident than before. You really think you're ready to challenge me?
Then let's do this!
Are you Haruka Sawamura-san?
Hm? Oh, yes, that's me. Who are you?
I serve the Amon Clan. I have a letter to give you.
Amon?
Go ahead. Take it.
My business with you is done.
(Who in the world is the Amon Clan? I guess I'd better read the letter and find out.)
(To Haruka Sawamura, my archrival. I await you in the parking lot of southwest Sotenbori. There we will settle things between us. -Noa Amon)
(What could this possibly be about? Who is Noa Amon? And what does she mean, "settle things"? I'd better head to the parking lot and figure this out.)
I'm impressed! I didn't know you were that good.
Looks like I take the win. You weren't too bad yourself, you know.
You want to challenge me, at your skill level? You're kidding, right?
Are you looking for a dance battle opponent?
No? Well, come on back if you ever change your mind.
You want a battle, in the condition you're in? Don't you think you're pushing yourself beyond your limits?
Hmm, you might be right. Maybe I'd better take a break.
Yes, actually. I am.
Aha! Then you found your man!
Well, that was quite a game.
We're offering a little contest here for couples who play together. Would you care to try it out?
A contest?
That's right, it's called Prize Bank Shot. We have the names of some prizes written on the pool table.
Make a bank shot onto one to win that prize! Simple, right?
Your lady friend will have to work extra hard for some of these prizes. What do you say?
Hahaha! That sure sounds like fun. Good luck, Kiryu-san!
Ooh! That sounds like fun. Good luck, Saejima-san!
Haha! Sounds like it could be fun. Go get 'em, Akiyama-san!
Well, I suppose that might be fun. Give it your best shot, Shinada-san!
Hey, that sounds like fun! You can do it, Kiryu-san!
All right, then!
I really have to pose like a panther?
Well, okay, then... I'll do it, just for you, %s-san. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Pose like a panther? Really?
Fine... But only 'cause you deserve it, %s-san. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Oh, my. A panther pose? Do I really have to?
Well, if you say so. But this is a special treat for your eyes only, %s-san. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Let me get this straight. You want me to do a panther pose!? That's kind of freaky, isn't it?
Fine... Just this one time!
Wait, you really want me to pose like a panther?
Well, fine... But only for you, %s-san. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Haha! Sounds like fun. Good luck, Kiryu-san.
Oh, my. A panther pose? Must I really?
Sheesh. You're in a different class. That'll teach me to challenge strangers...
Heh, that was entertaining. Thanks.
Say, there. If you have the time, how about a game of billiards?
Sorry. Ain't got that sort of time.
That so? Too bad.
Heh, this should be good.
You're quite the hustler. I honestly didn't foresee losing.
Thank you. That was most enjoyable.
Hello. Would you care to join me for a game of pool?
I'm kind of busy now.
Sure, let's play.
Great! Let's get right to it, then.
Wow, you're even better than I imagined!
What a shame. I thought you'd be more of a challenge.
Sorry, but I only accept an opponent of about the same skill level. Could you ask somebody else?
Oh, hey. Are you looking for a dance opponent?
Sorry, but I'm not.
Hey, wait a minute. It doesn't seem like you have enough energy for this right now.
I guess you're right. I apologize.
Yes, I am. Would you mind?
Not at all. Hehe! This should be good!
Wow, you're really good!
Hehe! Looks like I'm the winner!
Sorry, but I don't have any interest in battles that won't provide a challenge. Come back and see me once you've gotten a little better.
Hey, you! Wanna have a dance battle?
I'm sorry. Maybe some other time.
But when, exactly!?
Sorry, but you seem too tired.
Yes, that would be great.
Good! Let's do it, then!
I spend my time hanging around right here, so stop by when you get a chance. If you don't see me, I'm probably off somewhere grabbing a bite.
Fine. But for now, I'm going home. I'll humor you some other time.
I'll be waiting. See ya!
(Not happy about being out this late. I should really get home.)
(On second thought, maybe I could use some fresh air.)
(All right, I'm out of here.)
Heh. So you <Italic>do</Italic> have some fight in you.
Satisfied? I have better things to be doing right now.
C'mon, I couldn't be satisfied after that. I was barely even trying!
Yeah, that's what everyone says after they get laid out.
C'mon, old man. You must've felt it. Neither of us were giving it our all, and you damn well know it.
(He sure is pushy.)
You've been outta the game a while, old man. I could scrape the rust off of you with a knife.
Unless you fix that, you're gonna have a rough road ahead.
So why don't I give you some pointers, help you brush up? I'll have you back in tip-top shape in no time flat.
All I want in return is the fight of a lifetime. Once you're back in your prime, I mean. Well?
You think I'd accept help from someone who just attacked me for no reason?
Hey, there was a reason. Soon as you gimme the fight I want, I'll spill. I've got nothing to hide.
You've just gotta earn it first.
You're a real pain in the neck, you know that?
I'll take that as a compliment. Anyway, you know where to find me. Come back when you wanna tango.
...If I feel like it.
This'll do the trick.
Well? What do you want from me?
Straight to the point, just how I like it. Then I won't mince words.
I wanna fight you.
I could tell you were holding back on the thugs in that club. If anything, you were just venting a bit. I know I'm right.
As for what got you all wound up, no frickin' clue. One thing's for sure: you need an outlet for all that aggression.
And no better way to let it all out than a good old-fashioned fistfight. Doesn't have to be any more complicated than that.
You're reading too much into it. Besides, I have no reason to fight you.
You need a reason? Damn. Some "way of the warrior" shit right there. I like it!
Hard to explain it all now, but we have more reason to fight than you realize. Vague, I know. But trust me.
If that ain't enough, though... there's nothing stopping me from coming at you right here, right now.
Need a better reason than that? Didn't think so. Now get ready, old man, 'cause here I come!
So you finally showed.
I saw you tear those guys a new one back there. Acting the hero, saving the girl... Pretty smooth, I must admit.
Uh... Thanks.
Hey, don't be like that. I mean it.
Anyway, I didn't really see you around here much until, oh I don't know, six months ago? And you don't talk like a local, so... you're from out of town, right?
Maybe.
Heh, you don't have to tell me if you don't want. Someone who's lived as long as you's gotta have a few things they'd rather keep to themself.
Oh, right. Duh. I haven't introduced myself.
The name's Sosuke Komaki. Sosuke the Exterminator. I rid the streets of whatever trash floats to the surface. Punks, thugs, hooligans⑬you name it.
Komaki, huh?
Please, just call me Sosuke.
I've been watching you do your thing, and I gotta say, you move pretty quick for an old dude. I bet you were the real shit back in your prime.
The... what?
Like, you're on a whole 'nother level compared to the lameass bitches you see around town. Still got nothing on me, though.
...Do you need me for something, or can I go now?
Come on, chill out a sec. You're an outsider, I'm an outsider. Folks like us oughta stick together, don't you think?
Besides, your performance back there got me curious. I can't let you walk away just yet.
Just cut to the chase already. What is it you want, exactly?
Piqued your interest, did I? Good.
Only thing is, we're in earshot of like, the entire city here. Mind if we take this somewhere private?
That was a real hoot, huh? Think I'll request that girl Mayumi-chan next time.
Well, it's up and at 'em again in the mornin'! G'night!
Get home safe, sir.
(Well, tomorrow's another day. Time to head home.)
One o' my taxi buddies said this Olivier place'll fix ya up a real hootin' time.
Hm? Somethin' wrong? Y'know it, Suzuki-san?
Er, no.
Will it be just the two of you tonight?
Yep! Set me up with the most breathtakin' gal ya got on staff! I want yer number one!
You'll be requesting her, then, sir? There's an additional charge for that.
And I ain't gonna pay it! Free'll do! Come on, show us the prettiest girl y'got!
Sir.
Sorry about him. I'll cover the request fee. We'll take your number one.
Very well. In that case, right this way, gentlemen.
It's getting pretty late, Chief. Another spot might be overdoing it a little.
C'mon, y'agreed to it n' everythin'! A man never goes back on his word! Right, Suzuki-san!?
I... guess.
Don't get yer briefs in a bunch! I know yer always savin' up cash to send off somewhere.
So tonight's a hundred percent on me! All I'm askin' is one lil cabaret club!
If that's all it'll be.
Y'want the real Hakata experience, no better place than one o' these here food stalls.
They <Italic>do</Italic> always seem to be packed full of paying customers.
You betcha. Droppin' by for a nightcap after y'filled yer belly somewhere else is practically a Hakata tradition.
That explains it.
Now c'mon, we're goin' in!
...This guy's some kind of monster.
He doesn't look like one o' the Yamagasa, though. Y'think he's with someone else?
I suggest you stay out of other people's business. Unless you're in the mood for some more pain.
Ease up, Suzuki-san. I think they've learned their lesson. Now get outta here.
Our bad!
Thank you for stepping in. I was in a real pinch there.
Eh, no biggie. Get yerself home safe, okay? Wouldn't want anyone worryin'.
Right. Oh, and thank you, too.
It was nothing.
Well, good night.
Y'sure pack a punch, Suzuki-san. I knew y'were tough, but ya walloped those poor saps into next week and back!
It was just a fluke.
Oh yeah? Eh, whatever. Onto the next stop!
Phew, that was great. Whaddya say, Suzuki-san? Y'like it?
Definitely. Mizutaki is really something special. I love soy-based hot pots, but I never realized one made with chicken broth could be so good.
I getcha, I getcha. I'm guessin' yer from Kanto if yer all about that soy broth?
Well, er...
Hehehe. Sorry, didn't mean to put ya on the spot like that.
Bet y'got some skeletons in the closet. Ya always get so flustered when I start pryin'.
Anyway, glad y'liked the food. Now how 'bout we go knock back a few cold ones?
I appreciate the offer, but haven't you had enough to drink, sir?
I'm fine, I'm fine. They used t'call me the Iron Stomach, y'know!
Did they, now?
C'mon, less questions n' more walkin'!
(He's pretty far gone, but I can tell he's enjoying himself. I'd better make sure he gets home okay.)
Hey, babe. Don't y'know it's dangerous to be walkin' alone this late?
